Kit summary

Haunting SlashBasic
Deals 240% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 30% chance to reduce 20% ATK of the target for 2 turns.
Forceful BlowActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 240% ATK DMG to a single enemy. If self Crit Rate reaches 100%, deals extra 120% ATK DMG, which ignores DEF. If self Crit Rate reaches 150%, deals extra 240% ATK DMG instead.
Double-ended Sword of Mana Lv.1In the duration of Forceful Blow, additionally increases Eliezer's Crit Rate by 40%. Also, refreshes the duration of all buffs on self after Forceful Blow ends.
Eldritch EnhancementPassiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
When a battle starts, increases ATK, DEF, and Max HP by 3% for all allies (excluding self). As for allies from the Eternal Sect, the attributes above are increased by 9% instead. Meanwhile, Eliezer's ATK, DEF, and Max HP are increased by 60% of the sum of allies' boosted amount respectively as well.
Double-ended Sword of Mana Lv.2When a battle starts, increases all allies' Crit DMG by 12%. As for allies from the Eternal Sect, increases Crit DMG by 36% instead. When multiple skills increase this attribute, only the strongest one will take effect.
Double-ended Sword of Mana Lv.3After Invisible Figure is cast, increases all allies' attribute bonuses granted by Eldritch Enhancement to 150% of the original for 2 turns of their own.
Invisible FigureActiveExclusive Lv.3
Grants self [Stealth] for 1 turn. Increases self Crit Rate by 50% and Crit DMG by 60% for 2 turns.
Double-ended Sword of Mana Lv.3After Invisible Figure is cast, increases all allies' attribute bonuses granted by Eldritch Enhancement to 150% of the original for 2 turns of their own.
